sentences.text:
on 14 February, 2024 APHC010416802023  IN THE HIGH COURT OF ANDHRA PRADESH ::
 AMARAVATI  (Special Original Jurisdiction)
 [ 3330]
 WEDNESDAY ,THE FOURTEENTH DAY OF FEBRUARY  TWO THOUSAND AND TWENTY FOUR  PRESENT  THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHAR RAO  CONTEMPT CASE NO: 4838 OF 2023 Between:
RALLABANDI SASIBHUSHAN BHARADWAJ AND OTHERS ...PETITIONER(S)
 AND K SRIRAMULU AND OTHERS ...CONTEMNOR(S)
Counsel for the Petitioner(s):SRI. G V S MEHAR KUMAR Counsel for the Respondents: S SRAVANA SANDHYA The Court made the following:
Learned Government Pleader furnished a copy of the calculation memo and stated that rate was calculated at the rate of Rs.7,00,000/-per acre and have deposited approximately Rs.13,00,000/- before the authority under the Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 and agree to pay 9% interest after deducting the amount,
which was deposited before the authority and the said proposal was sent to the finance department and after approval from the Government, the same will be paid to the writ petitioner including the amount which was deposited before the authority under the Act, withdrawing the same.
Learned counsel for the petitioner disputed the calculations, filed by the learned Government Pleader and petitioner is permitted to file a fresh calculation memo.
Meanwhile, learned Government Pleader is directed to pay the amount, which was agreed, within a period of three (03) weeks from today, failing which, the respondents shall appear before this Court.
Rallabandi Sasibhushan Bharadwaj vs K.Sriramulu on 14 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149056542/
1

As directed by this Court on 07.02.2024, the 1st respondent appeared before this Court and he explained that he is not a competent authority under the Act and the Project director i.e., the Joint director is the competent authority under the Act.
Therefore, the presence of the 1st respondent is hereby dispensed with, for the present.
Post the matter after three (03) weeks.
_ __ TRR,J KBN [THE HONOURABLE SRI JUSTICE TARLADA RAJASEKHAR RAO]
